header: What changes for your crews in the first quarter
subheadline: Maintenance managers switch for one reason: the working day stops being a guessing game. Here is what the first ninety days usually look like for a team of twenty to a hundred and forty technicians.

items.title: Fewer hours lost to travel
items.description: Route-aware scheduling cut average travel time by 22 minutes per job at Halden Facilities, which is roughly one extra call per technician per day.

items.title: Higher first-time fix rate
items.description: Asset history, warranty status and the last three reports open with the job. Halden Facilities went from a 68% to an 81% first-time fix rate since March 2024.

items.title: Invoices out the same evening
items.description: Signed job sheets, parts used and travel time reach your accounting export the moment a technician closes the call, instead of on Friday afternoon.
